Parents and students should check local updates for any announcements. In some states, no school holiday has been confirmed for the day. However, there may be individual district decisions affecting school operations. It is advisable for parents to consult with their respective schools for the latest information.
 Agencies School Holiday Tomorrow, November 18, 2026: Are schools closed or open in Delhi, UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Odisha? Check state-wise updates
 As schools across several states prepare for the next academic day, students and parents are keen to know whether schools will remain open or observe a holiday tomorrow, November 18. School closure decisions may vary across states and districts depending on local weather conditions, government directives and administrative announcements. Students and parents are advised to check official school circulars, district administration updates and messages from their respective schools for the latest information on holiday announcements.
 School Holiday Tomorrow, November 18: State-Wise Status
 Delhi School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Schools in Delhi are expected to follow their regular schedule on Wednesday, November 18, as no fresh order announcing a citywide school holiday has been reported. Parents should check with their respective schools for updates on physical attendance and class timings.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Students and parents across Himachal Pradesh are checking whether schools will remain open or observe a holiday on Wednesday. As per the latest available updates, no statewide school holiday has been confirmed for November 18, and educational institutions are expected to follow their regular schedules.
 Uttar Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
 Live Events
 As per the latest available updates, schools in the state are expected to follow their regular schedules, with no statewide holiday confirmed for November 18. However, individual districts or schools may announce separate closures depending on local administrative decisions or their academic calendars. Parents are advised to check official school circulars and district administration updates before sending children to school.
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
 As per the latest available updates, schools in the state are expected to follow their regular academic schedule, with no statewide holiday announced for November 18. The 12-day mid-term Diwali vacation, which ran from November 4 to 15, has already concluded, and schools reopened on November 16.
 West Bengal School Holiday Tomorrow 
Students and parents across West Bengal are checking whether schools will remain closed or operate as usual on Wednesday. As per the latest available updates, schools are expected to follow their regular academic schedules, with no statewide school holiday confirmed for November 18.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Students and parents across Bihar are preparing for schools to reopen after an extended festive break. Schools are scheduled to resume regular classes on Wednesday, November 18, following an 11-day holiday from November 7 to 17 for Diwali, Chitragupt Puja, Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
As per the November 2026 holiday calendar, November 18 is marked as Anla Nabami, an optional holiday. Schools may remain open unless their respective heads decide to observe the holiday. No statewide school closure has been confirmed for the day. Parents are advised to check with school authorities for confirmation of holiday arrangements and any changes to regular class schedules.
